producer_fix: PaperSignalProducer and DecisionSignalProducer check both processed markers and read-only execution reservations (started:/completed:) without mutating existing reservations, and reuse any already-owned canonical journey for the exact resolved tenant/environment (never falling back across tenants) before falling back to uuid5-derived journey/correlation/trace for fresh decisions.
projector_recovery: A new-journey signal_generation, trade_decision, or no-op paper_order_simulated event whose decision/signal/run identifiers are already bound to one canonical journey is treated as a retry occurrence: it gets an 'ignored' receipt (source row retained, no rebinding, no quarantine, no readiness override) and records the canonical journey for producer reuse across code rollbacks. Decision-less no-op paper_order_simulated follow-ups are matched via signal_id and run_id; positive fills, downstream execution stages, differing signal/run, or another tenant/environment are never suppressed and raise IdentityConflictException; stores without resolve_identity are tolerated.
